title: Solids retention time at different temperatures (high rate digestion)
headers: Solids Retention Time, days / Suggested for Design (SRTd)

cell_spans.representation: printed once, centred across the full height of the two-tier header

markdown:
| Operating Temperature, °C | Solids Retention Time, days / SRTc | Solids Retention Time, days / Suggested for Design (SRTd) | Solids Retention Time, days / Ratio |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 18 | 11 | 28 | 28/11 = 2.54 |
| 24 | 8 | 20 | 20/8 = 2.5 |
| 30 | 6 | 14 | 14/6 = 2.3 |
| 35 | 4 | 10 | 10/4 = 2.5 |

notes: The table has a two-tier header. The top tier prints 'Operating Temperature, °C' in the left column and the group heading 'Solids Retention Time, days' across the three right-hand columns; the second tier prints 'SRTc', 'Suggested for Design (SRTd)' and 'Ratio'. headers flattens the tiers as 'group / leaf' and cell_spans records both printed merges.
The Ratio column prints its arithmetic together with the result, as '28/11 = 2.54', '20/8 = 2.5', '14/6 = 2.3', '10/4 = 2.5', '10/4 = 2.5'. Reproduced exactly as printed.
Printed rounding is inconsistent and is not corrected: 28/11 is actually 2.545..., printed as '2.54'; 14/6 is actually 2.333..., printed as '2.3'; 20/8, 10/4 and 10/4 are printed as '2.5'.
The degree symbol is printed as '°C' in 'Operating Temperature, °C'; kept.
Rows are printed as bare numbers with no unit in any temperature cell and no percent sign anywhere.
The header sub-labels print 'SRTc' and '(SRTd)' without a space or subscript; kept as printed rather than set with subscripts.
No footnote, source line or note is printed below this table.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of 144 dpi annotation-cleaned full-page PNGs plus 250-450 dpi detail crops of each item; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
